gitCommit.subject: Dukan ERP portal: dukan.tsxmr.com/subscription on its own cookie session, the confirmed trial claim, grace and messages
gitCommit.body:
Dukan ERP portal: dukan.tsxmr.com/subscription on its own cookie session, the confirmed trial claim, grace and messages

A third build surface, `portal` (VITE_SITE_SURFACE=portal, docs/101): the Owner's /subscription and the console at
/admin, no page of the company site (the public pages are aliased to a stub), nothing indexed — robots refuses
everything, every response says noindex, no sitemap. Its gate pins its three origins: https://dukan.tsxmr.com (never
portal.tsxmr.com), https://tsxmr.com for the legal and support links, and https://api.tsxmr.com. The prerenderer
writes the shell alone; the root redirects to /subscription, the old /account and /account/trial with 301.

- The Owner signs in on the portal's own routes with the app's identity. The session is two HttpOnly SameSite=Strict
  cookies the API sets; the page holds no token and sends no bearer anywhere. It keeps the session's CSRF token in
  memory and sends it on every POST; an expired access cookie is refreshed once, shared by requests refused together.
- The claim takes two presses: the terms (starts at once, exactly 7 days / 168 hours, cannot be paused or restarted)
  and an explicit confirmation. Terms version 2026-10-18.
- A status panel from GET my-subscription/status: the access (working, read-only, stopped) in colour and words, the
  paid period, the grace and its allowance of three in any 12 months, how a renewal confirmed now counts, and where
  the subscription messages stand (WhatsApp first, the recorded fallback or failure reason).
- The portal instructions' delivery behind a disclosure (channel, masked destination, reason), resend kept.
- The Owner's optional email verified on the portal; payment instructions read from the server, shown only when it
  offers a provider with its real code.
- The setup link's landing and every token handling are gone. Apply (full build only) requires the WhatsApp number,
  email optional, and ends at the portal's sign-in.
- EN/FR/AR strings, RTL; unit, component and browser tests (portal: EN/FR/AR at 375 px and desktop, axe, headers);
  CI builds, audits and browses the portal surface.
